LEGAL & SUPPORT

Let’s stay in touch.

Tomesi Garden: solitaire, mahjong and small Japanese games in a ceramic garden, for iPhone and iPad. No ads, no account, offline; we collect no data.

Support

A question about the garden, a purchase to restore, feedback or a translation error? Write to us: support@tomesi.com · +33 9 72 16 41 97.

To get your purchase back on a new device, tap the round arrow in the offer or in the settings lantern, signed in with the same Apple Account.
